stories.short: Acquisition Total Issuing Solutions + sortie Worldpay
stories.story_fr: Le 9 janvier 2026, FIS a finalise l'acquisition de l'activite Issuer Solutions (rebaptisee FIS Total Issuing Solutions) et la cession simultanee de sa participation minoritaire de 45% dans Worldpay. La direction affirme que FIS exploite desormais l'ensemble de donnees financieres le plus complet du secteur, couvrant tout le cycle de vie de l'argent.
stories.story_en: On January 9, 2026, FIS closed the acquisition of the Issuer Solutions Business (rebranded FIS Total Issuing Solutions) and the simultaneous sale of its remaining 45% Worldpay minority stake. Management states FIS now operates the most comprehensive financial data set in the industry, spanning the entire money lifecycle.
stories.signal: Recentrage strategique majeur: entree dans l'emission de cartes a forte marge et sortie du capital de Worldpay le meme jour.

stories.story_fr: Au troisieme trimestre 2025, FIS a renforce sa suite produit via sa strategie build, buy, partner avec l'acquisition d'Amount, plateforme de credit. La direction relie cette operation a une performance commerciale forte sur tous les segments.
stories.story_en: In the third quarter of 2025, FIS enhanced its product suite through its build, buy, partner strategy with the acquisition of Amount, a lending platform. Management ties this to strong sales performance across all segments of the business.
stories.signal: Acquisition ciblee pour densifier l'offre bancaire au-dela de la croissance organique.
